#  41209 - Ecosystem Analysis Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **41209 - module is no longer offered from SS 2024**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Ecosystem Analysis**  |  
|  Ökosystemanalyse   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 2 - Environment and Natural Sciences   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. PD Dr.-Ing. habil. Molkenthin, Frank 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Understanding GIS technology and information management for ecosystem analysis, knowledge of data modelling and analysis with spatial references, skills working with GIS as Desktop application and using Web services, refresh of database and programming technology and workflow modelling, competences in GIS application in environmental and water related projects related to ecosystems and land-use changes. Basic understanding of statistical analysis methods for time and space related environmental data for ecosystem analysis.  |  
| Contents:  | The lectures deal with the introduction to GIS software, data and services, coordinate reference systems, vector data management and analysis, raster data management and analysis, GIS and related data base standards, information modelling within GIS, WEB-GIS and mobile GIS techniques and solutions, metadata and INSPIRE initiative, remote sensing data analysis, environmental information systems and Web portals, interfacing to other software systems and GIS as modelling framework. Besides general GIS application in environmental related projects a specific focus is given to data analysis for ecosystem relevant problems. Application examples and case studies are provided for student assignments as practical training using standard GIS software (e.g. ArcGIS and QGIS) and watershed management tools (e.g. SWAT).  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Basic knowledge in mathematics, statistics and computer sciences  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Practical training / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 90 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Teaching material and a list of recommended literature will be published in the Internet/Intranet,links will be given to the module participants.  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Three assignments during the semester (each 10% -> all togehter 30%)
  * Written exam (70%)The written exam will be offered two times during the semester (e.g. last week of lecture period, mid of September). To pass the module, participants needs 50% of the total points from the assignments and the written exam. Participants have to participate in at least one of the two offered written exams. Participants can participate in both written exams, in this case the mean value of the two results will be considered for the final mark.

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | The module is a phase-out module. It is not offered any more since summer semester 2020! Registration to this phase-out module is not possible.Students looking for a resit based on a participation in the past should contact the responsible staff members.  |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * 240601 Lecture Ecosystem Analysis
  * 240607 Exercise/Practical training Practical training Ecosystem Analysis
  * 240646 Examination Ecosystem Analysis
  * 240647 Examination Ecosystem Analysis

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 24.01.2012 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
